era: 1877 年生于浙江海宁双仁巷一书香之家，父王乃誉工书画——'幼不喜帖括之学'；16 岁入杭州崇文书院，两次乡试不第，甲午之败'始知世尚有新学'；1898 年入上海《时务报》任司书校对，入东文学社习日文与科学，得罗振玉赏识；1901 年留学东京物理学校，因病归国——此后十年执教通州、苏州师范，专治哲学（康德、叔本华、尼采）、美学与词曲之学，著《红楼梦评论》《人间词话》《宋元戏曲考》，自序'人生之问题日往复于吾前'；1911 年辛亥后随罗振玉东渡京都，弃西学而专治经史小学——自言'以余之长而益以余之短'；1913-1925 年著《殷卜辞中所见先公先王考》《殷周制度论》《流沙坠简》（与罗振玉）——甲骨金文简牍之学开一代风气，郭沫若称'我们要说殷虚的发现是新史学的开端，王国维是开山'；1923 年受逊帝溥仪'南书房行走'之命；1925 年应聘清华国学研究院导师，与梁启超、陈寅恪、赵元任并称四大导师，讲授《古史新证》立'二重证据法'；1927 年 6 月 2 日自沉于颐和园昆明湖，遗书'五十之年，只欠一死；经此世变，义无再辱'——陈寅恪撰碑铭：'独立之精神，自由之思想'，为二十世纪中国学术立精神界碑
era_en: Born 1877 into a scholar's house in Haining, Zhejiang, his father skilled in calligraphy and painting — 'in boyhood he had no taste for examination essays'; at sixteen he entered the Chongwen Academy in Hangzhou, failed the provincial examination twice, and after the defeat of 1894 'first knew that there were new studies in the world'; in 1898 he joined the Chinese Progress in Shanghai as proofreader, entered the Eastern Language School for Japanese and the sciences, and won the recognition of Luo Zhenyu; in 1901 he sailed for the physics school in Tokyo, returning home through illness — then ten years teaching at Tongzhou and Suzhou normal schools, devoted to philosophy (Kant, Schopenhauer, Nietzsche), aesthetics and the study of ci and drama, writing the Essay on the Dream of the Red Chamber, the Remarks on Ci in the Human World, the History of Song-Yuan Drama, with the self-account that 'the question of life circles before me daily'; after the 1911 revolution he crossed to Kyoto with Luo Zhenyu, abandoning Western studies for classics, history and philology; from 1913 to 1925 he wrote the Investigations of the Yin Sovereigns in the Oracle Inscriptions, On the Institutions of Yin and Zhou, and the Simple Slips from the Flowing Sands (with Luo) — opening the era of oracle-bone, bronze and slip studies; Guo Moruo called him 'the trailblazer, if the finds at Yin-hsü are the beginning of the new historiography'; in 1923 he was appointed companion of the Southern Study by the abdicated emperor Puyi; in 1925 he took the post of tutor at the Tsinghua Research Institute of National Learning, ranked with Liang Qichao, Chen Yinke and Zhao Yuanren as one of the Four Great Tutors, lecturing the New Evidence on Ancient History and legislating the double-evidence method; on 2 June 1927 he drowned himself in Kunming Lake, leaving the testament 'fifty years of age; only death remains owed; having passed through this upheaval of the world, honour permits no second disgrace' — Chen Yinke's stele inscription, 'independence of spirit, freedom of thought', set the spiritual boundary-stone of twentieth-century Chinese scholarship
school: 二重证据史学 / 甲骨金文学 / 殷周制度研究 / 境界美学 / 康德-叔本华哲学引介 / 戏曲史与古雅说 / 疑信互限方法论
historical_significance: 中国现代学术的开山者：他把甲骨文从古董变成史料——《殷卜辞中所见先公先王考》以卜辞重写商王世系，郭沫若称'殷虚的发现是新史学的开端，王国维是开山'；《殷周制度论》以亲属制度解释制度革命，把史学的解释单位从王朝兴替改写为结构变革；'二重证据法'为全部现代古史研究立法——证据的效力来自来源的异质冗余，纸上孤证必须接受地下实证的审问；他以《人间词话》的'境界说'重排千年词史，以《红楼梦评论》为中国文学办了'独立户口'，以《古雅之在美学上之位置》引进康德美学并为其增设新范畴；清华国学研究院四大导师之首，陈寅恪碑铭'独立之精神，自由之思想'成为二十世纪中国学术的界碑；1927 年昆明湖自沉，以生命完成'忧生'命题的最终判例——把思想推到不能回头的深度
historical_significance_en: The trailblazer of modern Chinese scholarship: he turned oracle bones from curiosities into sources — the Investigations rewrote the Shang king list from the inscriptions, and Guo Moruo called him 'the trailblazer, if the finds at Yin-hsü are the beginning of the new historiography'; On the Institutions of Yin and Zhou explained institutional revolution through kinship institutions, rewriting the explanatory unit of history from dynastic rise and fall to structural change; the 'double-evidence method' legislated for all modern study of ancient history — an evidence's force comes from the heterogeneous redundancy of its sources, and the lone testimony on paper must submit to interrogation by buried proof; with the 'theory of the realm' in the Remarks on Ci he re-ranked a millennium of ci poetry; with the Red Chamber essay he registered Chinese literature as independent; with On the Position of Classical Elegance he imported Kant's aesthetics and installed a new category in its gap; first of the Four Great Tutors of the Tsinghua Research Institute, his stele epitaph by Chen Yinke — 'independence of spirit, freedom of thought' — became the boundary-stone of twentieth-century Chinese scholarship; his self-drowning in Kunming Lake in 1927 completed the final case of 'sorrow for life' with his own body — thinking driven to the depth from which there is no turning back
unique_thinking: 王国维的思维内核是'证据与形式的自律'：一切论断都要过两道闸门——证据闸门（二重证据、异质冗余）与形式闸门（境界、雅正、不隔）；第二个内核是'坐标系优先'的冷材料方法：面对无人能读的甲骨，他不硬啃字而先立世系与祀谱的坐标——结构带出意义，学科随之而生；第三个内核是'体系空档立法'：康德的优美/壮美解释不了的中间带，他为它命名'古雅'并论证其可学性——评价体系的立法权属于发现空档的人；第四个内核是疑信互限：怀疑不等于否定，未被证明者悬置待证，裁判权交给新出土的材料；第五个内核是思想与行为同构：从'境界说'到昆明湖，他把'人生之问题'研究了一生——所有答案都必须能对齐自己的生命实践，'五十之年，只欠一死'是这个体系在身体层面的最后判例
unique_thinking_en: Wang Guowei's cognitive core is the autonomy of evidence and form: every claim passes two gates — the evidence gate (double evidence, heterogeneous redundancy) and the form gate (realm, rectitude, the unveiled); his second core is the coordinate-first handling of cold material: facing oracle bones nobody could read, he did not grind at the characters but first built the frame of lineage and cult cycle — structure elicits meaning, and a discipline is born with it; the third core is legislating for the system's gaps: the middle band Kant's beautiful and sublime could not explain he named 'classical elegance' and argued its learnability — the power to legislate an evaluative system belongs to whoever finds the gap; the fourth core is the mutual limiting of doubt and trust: doubt is not denial, the unverified stands suspended pending proof, and jurisdiction belongs to newly excavated material; the fifth core is the isomorphism of thought and act: from the theory of the realm to Kunming Lake he studied 'the question of life' all his life — every answer had to align with his own life practice, and 'fifty years of age; only death remains owed' is that system's final precedent at the level of the body
civilization_zh: 清末民初的学术转型期：科举废除与新式学堂并立造成的学问人身份重组、甲骨文敦煌文书简牍三大发现带来的新材料革命、罗振玉-王国维式的私人学术共同体与东渡日本的知识避难、康德叔本华哲学经日文译介进入汉语思想界的美学新资源、清华国学研究院'整理国故'与疑古论战并起的史学方法论场域、旧学根柢（词曲戏曲之学）与西学框架（美学/逻辑/哲学）嫁接的学科创生期
civilization_en: The scholarly transition of late Qing and early Republic: the re-sorting of scholarly identity as the examinations fell and the new schools rose, the material revolution brought by the three great finds — oracle bones, Dunhuang manuscripts, bamboo slips, the private academic commonwealth of Luo Zhenyu and Wang Guowei and the refuge of knowledge in exile to Japan, the new aesthetic resources of Kant and Schopenhauer entering Chinese thought through Japanese translation, the methodological field of the Tsinghua Research Institute where 'ordering the national heritage' and the doubting-the-ancients debate rose together, and the birth-period of disciplines grafted from old learning (the study of ci and drama) onto Western frameworks (aesthetics, logic, philosophy)
roles_zh: 史学家（《殷卜辞中所见先公先王考》《殷周制度论》、二重证据法的立法者）；文学家（《人间词话》《宋元戏曲考》、境界说与戏曲史的奠基者）；哲学家（康德、叔本华哲学的最早系统引介者）；文献学家（《流沙坠简》、金石器物之学）；教育家（清华国学研究院四大导师之首）
roles_en: Historian (the Investigations and the Institutions essay; legislator of the double-evidence method); literary scholar (the Remarks on Ci, the History of Song-Yuan Drama; founder of the theory of the realm and of Chinese drama history); philosopher (the earliest systematic importer of Kant and Schopenhauer into Chinese); philologist of documents (the Simple Slips from the Flowing Sands; the study of bronzes and inscriptions); educator (first of the Four Great Tutors of the Tsinghua Research Institute)

modes.domain_zh: 史学方法论/把'地下之新材料'与'纸上之遗文'并置互证——证据链的物理冗余取代文本权威的等级秩序
modes.domain_en: Historiographical methodology / setting 'new material from underground' beside 'transmitted texts on paper' for mutual verification — physical redundancy of the evidence chain replacing the hierarchy of textual authority
modes.definition_zh: 史学方法论/《古史新证》(1925)开篇立法：'吾辈生于今日，幸于纸上之材料外，更得地下之新材料'——王国维把证据从单一文本宇宙里解放出来，规定研究法则为二重：取地下之实物（甲骨、金文、竹简、封泥）与纸上之遗文（正史、子书、类书）互相释证，加上边裔（民族学）与域外（比较语言学）的辅助，构成多层证据网。其认识论要点有三：其一，证据的效力来自来源的异质冗余——两个独立来源相互印证，胜过一百部同源抄本的层层转引；其二，文本权威被降级为证据之一而非证据之首，《史记》殷本纪也要接受卜辞的审问；其三，二重证据不单是'证明'更是'发现'——卜辞不待证史已自是史料，地下之物常逼出纸上记载无法给出的问题。这条方法规则让'信古'与'疑古'的百年之争在证据面前同时失效：既不全信纸上的圣王叙事，也不轻疑地下已证的信史
modes.definition_en: Historiographical methodology: the opening of New Evidence on Ancient History (1925) legislates — 'we who live today are fortunate that, beyond the transmitted materials on paper, we have gained new materials from underground'; Wang Guowei freed evidence from a single textual universe and set the rule of research as double: physical objects from underground (oracle bones, bronzes, bamboo slips, clay seals) and transmitted texts (standard histories, masters, encyclopaedias) verify each other, with frontier ethnology and foreign comparative philology as auxiliaries — a multi-layer evidence web. Three epistemic points: first, an evidence's force comes from heterogeneous redundancy of sources — two independent sources checked against each other outweigh a hundred same-lineage copies layered through citation; second, textual authority is demoted from chief evidence to one item of evidence — even the Annals' chapter on Yin must submit to interrogation by the oracle inscriptions; third, the double evidence does not only 'prove' but 'discovers' — the oracle bones are sources before any need to confirm the texts, and what the ground yields often forces questions the paper record cannot pose. This one rule made the century-old quarrel between 'trusting the ancients' and 'doubting the ancients' fail simultaneously before the evidence: neither wholly believing the paper sagas nor lightly doubting the verified history underground
modes.source_chapter: 《古史新证》(1925，清华国学研究院讲义)；《殷卜辞中所见先公先王考》(1917)
modes.key_quote_zh: 吾辈生于今日，幸于纸上之材料外，更得地下之新材料——证据的效力，来自来源的异质冗余。
modes.key_quote_en: We who live today are fortunate that, beyond the transmitted materials on paper, we have gained new materials from underground — an evidence's force comes from the heterogeneous redundancy of its sources.
key_concepts: 异质冗余 heterogenous redundancy（独立来源互证强于同源转引——证据网而非证据链）
heterogenous redundancy (independent sources verify each other better than same-lineage citation — a web of evidence, not a chain)
文本降级 demotion of the text（经典是证据之一不是证据之首——《史记》也要受卜辞审问）
demotion of the text (the classic is one item of evidence, not the chief — even the Annals submits to the oracle bones)
证与发现并存 proof and discovery together（地下之物不仅印证也逼出新问题）
proof and discovery together (what the ground yields does not only confirm but forces new questions)
process_zh: 先清点两库：纸上遗文有哪些、地下新材料有哪些——列成证据清单而非先写结论
逐条互证：每一项纸载在地下找对应物，每一件地下遗物在纸载里找位置——对得上则双重加固
处理缺口：对不上处不强行弥合——标注'阙疑'留待新出土物，而非曲说调停
吸收辅助证据：边裔民族学与域外语言学做第三重校验——证据网随来源扩展而加密
process_en: Inventory the two stores first: what transmitted texts hold, what new underground material holds — an evidence list before any conclusion
Cross-verify item by item: for each textual entry seek its underground counterpart, for each buried object seek its place in the texts — where they meet, the finding is doubly fixed
Handle the gaps: where they mismatch, do not force a splice — mark the doubt and wait for new excavated items rather than bend either side
Absorb auxiliary evidence: frontier ethnology and comparative philology form a third check — the web tightens as its sources widen
representative_cases_zh: 《殷卜辞中所见先公先王考》：从甲骨卜辞考出殷先公先王世系，与《史记·殷本纪》大体相合而纠正其误——上甲以下十二世一一落到实土，纸上孤证变成地下实证
《殷周制度论》：以金文、卜辞与文献三重证据立论，判定殷周之际为中国制度史上最大变革——嫡庶之制、宗法、丧服皆自周公立制而来
流沙坠简：与罗振玉据斯坦因所获汉晋木简作《流沙坠简》，纸上汉书记载与地下简牍互证，重写了西北边疆的行政史实
representative_cases_en: In An Investigation of the Yin Sovereigns seen in the Oracle Inscriptions he recovered the genealogy of the pre-dynastic and early Shang kings from the oracle bones and set it against the Annals' Basic Annals of Yin — broadly matching, correcting its errors: twelve generations from Shang Jia down set onto real soil, a lone paper testimony become buried proof

In On the Institutions of Yin and Zhou he argued from bronzes, oracle bones and transmitted texts together that the Yin-Zhou transition was the greatest institutional change in Chinese history — primogeniture, the lineage system, mourning ranks all legislated by the Duke of Zhou

In the Simple Slips from the Flowing Sands, with Luo Zhenyu he read the Han-Jin wooden slips Stein had carried out of the desert: paper records of the Han and buried slips verifying each other, rewriting the administrative history of the northwestern frontier
modern_applications_zh: 技术尽调：报表（纸上遗文）之外必取运营数据与实地访谈（地下新材料）——两个独立来源互证才算闭环
历史校准：用现行可验证数据（卜辞）审问企业历史叙事（殷本纪）——品牌故事也要接受数据降级
证据制度设计：核心结论要求'异质冗余'——不同渠道、不同方法各自独立到达同一结论
modern_applications_en: Technical due diligence: beyond the financial statements (paper texts), take operations data and field interviews (underground material) — two independent sources must converge before the loop closes
Historical calibration: interrogate the firm's founding narrative (the Annals) with verifiable current data (the oracle bones) — brand stories too are demoted to evidence among evidence
Evidence-governance design: core conclusions require heterogeneous redundancy — different channels and methods arriving independently at the same result
representative_figures: 王国维（核心）
罗振玉（同盟：甲骨、简牍、金石的收集与刊布——二重证据的'地下'一库的主要供给者）
顾颉刚（对手兼受益者：疑古派以'层累'攻古史，王国维以'地下实证'立限——二说共同划定现代古史边界）

modes.domain_zh: 史学方法论/从'最冷门'的一手材料重写王朝史——新学科的开辟往往从人人读不懂的材料开始
modes.domain_en: Historiographical methodology / rewriting a dynasty's history from the most recondite first-hand material — new disciplines open precisely from the sources nobody else can read
modes.definition_zh: 史学方法论/1917 年王国维连发三考（《殷卜辞中所见先公先王考》《续考》及《殷周制度论》），把一批 1899 年才被发现、无人能读的刻骨，直接变成一部可信的商王朝史——操作要点不在'认字'而在方法：其一，以世系为骨架：先从卜辞中辑出祭祀称谓，拼出先公先王的名号序列，再与《殷本纪》对照——以谱系结构做读解的坐标系，个别字不识不影响整体互证；其二，以祀谱定年代：周祭轮次自成周期，据此可定卜辞王世的绝对框架；其三，容许渐进：不识之字存而不论，已识部分先行成文——考释是迭代过程而非一次性工程。这条方法的深层示范是：一门学问的'不可读'不等于'不可研究'——建立坐标系（世系、周期、形制）之后，冷材料按坐标系逐格归位，整个学科随之诞生。甲骨学由此从古董玩赏变成史学分科
modes.definition_en: Historiographical methodology: in 1917 Wang issued three studies in succession — the Investigations of the Yin Sovereigns in the Oracle Inscriptions, their sequel, and On the Institutions of Yin and Zhou — turning a hoard of inscribed bones, discovered only in 1899 and readable by no one, directly into a credible history of the Shang; the operative point lies not in 'reading characters' but in method: first, the genealogy as frame: collect the sacrificial appellations from the inscriptions, assemble the sequence of pre-dynastic and early sovereigns, then set it against the Annals — the lineage structure serves as the coordinate system of interpretation, and single unread characters do not block the whole mutual verification; second, the sacrificial cycle for dating: the rotating cult schedule has its own period, from which an absolute frame for the reigns of each inscription group can be fixed; third, allow the gradual: characters not yet read are set aside without comment, the read parts written up first — decipherment is iteration, not a one-shot campaign. The deep lesson: a body of material 'unreadable' is not 'unresearchable' — once a coordinate system (lineage, cycle, form) is built, the cold material falls into its grid cell by cell, and a discipline is born with it. Oracle-bone studies thereby passed from connoisseurship into a branch of history
modes.source_chapter: 《殷卜辞中所见先公先王考》及《续考》(1917)；《戬寿堂所藏殷虚文字考释》(1917)
modes.key_quote_zh: 材料不可读，不等于不可研究——先立坐标系，冷材料按格归位，学科随之而生。
modes.key_quote_en: That the material cannot be read does not mean it cannot be studied — build the coordinate system first, and the cold material falls into its grid, a discipline born with it.
key_concepts: 坐标系优先 coordinates first（谱系与周期先于个别识字——结构带出意义）
coordinates first (genealogy and cycle precede single-character readings — structure elicits meaning)
祀谱定年 dating by the cult cycle（让材料自带的周期当尺子——不外借权威）
dating by the cult cycle (let the material's own period serve as the ruler — no borrowed authority)
渐进成文 writing by stages（已识部分先行，未识存档——迭代而非冲刺）
writing by stages (write up the read first, archive the unread — iterate, do not sprint)
process_zh: 找'没人读得懂'的一手材料——冷门本身是蓝海：无人竞争且供给集中
建立坐标系：从材料内部结构（世系/周期/形制）提炼参照系——不依赖外部权威注疏
局部先行：已解部分按坐标系成文发表——用已锁定区块带动未解区块
对照外部记载：坐标系建成后与旧文本逐格核对——发现旧文本的误、漏、缺
process_en: Find the first-hand material no one can read — obscurity itself is blue ocean: no rivals, concentrated supply
Build the coordinate system: extract the frame from the material's internal structure (lineage, cycle, form) — no reliance on external authority
Write up what is read: publish the solved cells against the frame — locked blocks draw the unlocked into place
Check against the legacy record: with the frame built, verify the old texts cell by cell — surfacing their errors, omissions and gaps
representative_cases_zh: 从祭祀称谓辑出上甲至示癸六位先公，与《殷本纪》'报丁报乙报丙'次序互勘——发现《史记》世次有误而卜辞为正，孤证翻案全凭谱系坐标
以周祭轮次定卜辞王世分组：各类卜辞先按祀谱排期，再系于商王——此后甲骨分期断代皆以此法为起点
不识之字注'待考'而不强解——董作宾后来正是在这批'待考'标记上发展出五期分法
representative_cases_en: From the sacrificial appellations he assembled the six pre-dynastic sovereigns Shang Jia through Shi Gui, checked them against the Annals' order Bao Ding, Bao Yi, Bao Bing — the Annals' sequence proved wrong and the inscriptions right, a lone testimony overturned purely by the genealogical frame
By the rotating cult schedule he grouped the inscriptions by reign — every later periodisation of the oracle bones starts from this move
Unread characters were annotated 'pending' and never forced — Dong Zuobin later built his five-period chronology exactly on those 'pending' marks
modern_applications_zh: 进入新领域：从'没人整理'的一手数据开始——行业日志、客服录音、原始流水
建坐标系：先从数据内部结构提炼参照系（时间/层级/流程），不依赖现成报表口径
发布节奏：已验证部分先行成文——用已锁定区块的信用带动未解区块的协作
modern_applications_en: Enter a new field from the first-hand data nobody has processed — field logs, call recordings, raw transactions
Build the coordinate system first: extract the frame from the data's own structure (time, hierarchy, flow), not from inherited report formats
Publish in stages: write up the verified first — the credit of locked blocks recruits collaborators for the unread ones
representative_figures: 王国维（核心）
刘鹗、罗振玉（上游：甲骨的收藏、著录与初释——《铁云藏龟》《殷虚书契》提供了原料库）
董作宾（下游：在王国维祀谱框架上建立五期分法与断代工程）

modes.domain_zh: 制度史学/从葬俗与称谓等'小证据'推出制度变革的'大结论'——立制的第一因藏在亲属结构里
modes.domain_en: Institutional historiography / deriving the 'grand conclusion' of institutional change from 'small evidence' like burial customs and forms of address — the first cause of institution-building hides in kinship structure
modes.definition_zh: 制度史学/《殷周制度论》(1917) 的推理结构是现代社会科学式的：起点是一个可观察的小差异——殷人祭祖'亲尽则毁'，周人立'文王世子'之制；由此逐步上推：周人立子立嫡之制→嫡庶之别→宗法与丧服之制→同姓不婚→分封子弟→'尊尊亲亲'的礼制秩序，最终判词：'中国政治与文化之变革，莫剧于殷周之际'——殷周之变不是改朝换代而是'旧文化废而新文化兴'的制度革命。方法论要点有三：其一，从亲属制度推政治制度：家内继承规则是政治秩序的第一因，立嫡一事牵动整个封建与礼制；其二，制度整体论：诸制度非并列而互锁——宗法、封建、丧服、婚姻是一个自洽系统，抽其一块全盘动摇；其三，以'制度'而非'事件'为史的单位：商汤伐桀是事件，立嫡立子是制度——后者才构成文明的分水岭。这把史学的解释单位从王朝兴替改写为结构变革，直接启发了此后的周代封建研究与社会史路径
modes.definition_en: Institutional historiography: the inferential structure of On the Institutions of Yin and Zhou (1917) is that of modern social science. It starts from an observable small difference — the Yin ancestors' cult 'ends as kinship ends', while the Zhou set up the institution of the King Wen heir apparent; from there it climbs step by step: Zhou succession by the son of the principal wife → the distinction of principal and lesser descent → the lineage (zongfa) and mourning systems → exogamy of the surname → enfeoffment of kin → the ritual order of 'honour the honoured, befriend the kin' — to the verdict that 'no change in Chinese politics and culture was greater than at the transition from Yin to Zhou': not a change of dynasty but an institutional revolution, 'the old culture abolished, the new arising'. Three methodological points: first, derive political institutions from kinship institutions — the domestic rule of inheritance is the first cause of political order, and one rule of primogeniture moves the whole apparatus of enfeoffment and ritual; second, institutional holism: the institutions are not juxtaposed but interlocked — lineage, enfeoffment, mourning, marriage form one self-consistent system, and pull out one block and the whole shakes; third, the unit of history is the institution, not the event: Tang's overthrow of Jie is an event; the rule of succession is an institution — only the latter forms a watershed of civilisation. This rewrote the explanatory unit of history from dynastic rise and fall to structural change, and directly shaped all later study of the Zhou fief system and the social-history school
modes.key_quote_zh: 中国政治与文化之变革，莫剧于殷周之际——立嫡一制，牵动封建、宗法、礼乐的全部秩序。
modes.key_quote_en: No change in Chinese politics and culture was greater than at the transition from Yin to Zhou — one rule of succession moves the entire order of enfeoffment, lineage and ritual.
key_concepts: 亲属为第一因 kinship as first cause（家内继承规则决定政治秩序——立制从立嗣开始）
kinship as first cause (domestic inheritance rules decide political order — institution-building begins with succession)
制度互锁 institutional interlock（宗法/封建/丧服/婚姻是一个自洽系统——不可单件移植）
institutional interlock (lineage, enfeoffment, mourning, marriage form one self-consistent system — no single-piece transplant)
制度优先于事件 institution over event（事件是浪花，制度是河床——解释单位要选对）
institution over event (events are spray, institutions the riverbed — choose the unit of explanation well)
process_zh: 从可观察的小差异入手：葬俗、称谓、婚姻规则——微差异比宏大叙事更可靠
沿因果链上推：一个继承规则如何改变亲属关系，亲属关系如何再组织土地与人身
整体校验：把推出的诸制度拼成系统，检查互锁是否自洽——孤例不成制度
给出历史判词：以制度变革为尺度标注文明分水岭——而不是以王朝更替为界
process_en: Start from observable small differences: burial customs, forms of address, marriage rules — micro-differences beat grand narratives
Climb the causal chain: how one succession rule reorders kinship, how reordered kinship reorganises land and persons
Check as a whole: assemble the derived institutions into a system and test the interlocks for consistency — one case makes no institution
Deliver the verdict: mark the watershed of a civilisation by institutional change, not by the fall of a dynasty
representative_cases_zh: 由'文王世子'一条上推得出嫡长继承→宗法分封→同姓不婚的完整链条，再用《左传》《礼记》与金文称谓逐环验证
指出殷人兄终弟及与周人父死子继之别非偶然而是制度选择——把夏商周断代的叙事从'三代相似'改写为'殷周革命'
后世'殷周之际社会变革'诸说（封建说、奴隶制说）无论结论异同，皆以《殷周制度论》的问题结构为起点
representative_cases_en: From the single institution of the King Wen heir he derived the whole chain of primogeniture → lineage and enfeoffment → surname exogamy, verifying each link against the Zuo Commentary, the Rites and bronze appellations

He showed the Yin practice of brother-to-brother succession against Zhou father-to-son was no accident but an institutional choice — recasting the narrative of the Three Dynasties from 'sameness' into a 'Yin-Zhou revolution'
Every later theory of social transformation at the Yin-Zhou transition — fief-based, slave-society or otherwise — starts from the problem structure of the Institutions essay, whatever its conclusions
modern_applications_zh: 组织转型诊断：先看最小可观察差异（谁被提拔、谁能进哪间会议室）——微规则是文化变革的第一因
制度设计：任何新制度先检查与既有制度族的互锁——单件移植会整体漏水
变革叙事：把'换了谁'改写为'改了哪条规则'——向团队解释变革时以制度而非人事为单位
modern_applications_en: Organisational transformation diagnosis: start from the smallest observable differences (who gets promoted, who may enter which meeting) — micro-rules are the first cause of cultural change
Institutional design: check every new rule against the interlocks of the existing rule-family — single-piece transplants leak everywhere
Change narrative: rewrite 'who was replaced' as 'which rule was changed' — explain transformation in institutions, not personnel
representative_figures: 王国维（核心）
司马光（对照：'才德论'以人事为史之枢机，王国维以亲属制度为枢机——两种历史解释单位）
许倬云、李峰（下游：西周封建与国家形成的现代研究皆循'制度互锁'的问题结构）

modes.domain_zh: 美学批评/以'境界'为文学的唯一品级标准——评价体系立法：抓准一个核心范畴胜过千条细则
modes.domain_en: Aesthetic criticism / making 'the realm' (jingjie) the sole standard for ranking literature — legislating an evaluative system: one core category seized precisely beats a thousand rules
modes.definition_zh: 美学批评/《人间词话》(1908-1909) 开篇立法：'词以境界为最上。有境界则自成高格，自有名句'——王国维此前已试过'兴趣''神韵'诸说，皆嫌隔靴搔痒，最终选定'境界'一词统摄全部批评。其方法论要点：其一，范畴要能两向展开——'有我之境/无我之境'、'造境/写境'、'隔/不隔'，一个核心词分裂出可操作的对子，批评才有了可用的手术刀；其二，范畴要能落地为判例——他不空谈境界，而是逐句判：'红杏枝头春意闹'着一'闹'字而境界全出，'云破月来花弄影'着一'弄'字而境界全出；其三，评价标准的立法要敢于覆盖旧标准——不谈格律派别，直接以有无境界重排千年词史，五代北宋因境界而高，南宋因雕琢而降。结果是一部三卷札记体的短书重写了文学批评史——证明评价体系的立法权属于'抓住核心范畴的人'，不属于条文最多的人
modes.definition_en: Aesthetic criticism: the opening of Remarks on Ci in the Human World (1908-09) legislates — 'of ci poetry, that which has a realm stands highest; with a realm it achieves its own nobility, its own famous lines'; Wang had tried 'interest' and 'resonance' before and found them scratching through the boot, and settled at last on the one word 'realm' to govern all criticism. The method: first, a category must unfold in two directions — 'the realm with self / without self', 'made realm / written realm', 'veiled / unveiled' — one core word splits into operable pairs, and criticism acquires a working scalpel; second, the category must land as case law — he does not discourse on realm in the abstract but judges line by line: in 'spring stirs on the apricot-bough tips' the single verb 'stirs' calls forth the whole realm; in 'cloud breaks, moon comes, blossoms play with shadow' the single 'play' calls forth the whole realm; third, legislating a standard takes nerve to cover the old ones — no talk of schools or prosody; he re-ranks a thousand years of ci purely by presence of realm: Five Dynasties and Northern Song high because of realm, Southern Song fallen to ornament. The result: a short book of notebook form rewrote the history of criticism — proving that the power to legislate an evaluative system belongs to whoever seizes the core category, not to whoever writes the most rules
modes.key_quote_zh: 词以境界为最上——评价体系的立法权属于抓住核心范畴的人，不属于条文最多的人。
modes.key_quote_en: Of ci, that which has a realm stands highest — the power to legislate an evaluative system belongs to whoever seizes the core category, not to whoever writes the most rules.
key_concepts: 核心范畴 single core category（一个词统摄全部批评——比千条细则更有穿透力）
single core category (one word governs all criticism — more piercing than a thousand rules)
对子展开 paired unfolding（有我/无我、隔/不隔——范畴分裂成可操作对子）
paired unfolding (with-self / without-self, veiled / unveiled — the category splits into operable pairs)
判例落地 case-law grounding（着一字而境界全出——标准必须能逐句裁决）
case-law grounding (one verb and the whole realm stands forth — a standard must adjudicate line by line)
process_zh: 找核心范畴：候选标准逐一试刀，留下穿透力最强的一个——如'境界'之于'兴趣''神韵'
展开成对子：核心词分裂为可操作的两极——抽象标准变成可打分的对照
逐句判例：用范畴裁决具体作品——'着一字而境界全出'式的精细判例库
敢于重排座次：以新标准重写整个领域的等级史——立法者不迁就旧共识
process_en: Hunt the core category: test each candidate standard with the knife, keep the one that penetrates — 'realm' over 'interest' and 'resonance'
Unfold it into pairs: split the core word into operable poles — the abstract standard becomes a scoreable contrast
Adjudicate line by line: apply the category to concrete works — a case library in the style of 'one verb and the realm stands forth'
Dare to re-rank: rewrite the field's whole hierarchy by the new standard — the legislator does not defer to old consensus
representative_cases_zh: '红杏枝头春意闹'着一'闹'字而境界全出——一个判例让'境界'从概念变成可操作的裁决工具
以境界重排词史：五代北宋高于南宋、姜夔不及辛弃疾——札记体短书颠覆了以格律派别论高下的旧批评秩序
'有我之境/无我之境'：'泪眼问花花不语'与'采菊东篱下'两判例把对子钉进批评史——后世凡论抒情主体必引
representative_cases_en: 'Spring stirs on the apricot-bough tips': one verb and the whole realm stands forth — a single case turned 'realm' from concept into working instrument
Re-ranking by realm: Five Dynasties and Northern Song above the Southern Song, Jiang Kui below Xin Qiji — a short notebook overthrew the old order that ranked by prosodic school

'Realm with self / without self': the two cases 'with tear-filled eyes I ask the flowers, the flowers do not speak' and 'picking chrysanthemums by the eastern fence' pinned the pair into critical history — cited whenever the lyric subject is discussed
modern_applications_zh: 评审制度设计：把千条打分细则压成一个核心范畴（如'是否改变了用户的心智'）——再展开为可对照的两极
写评审意见：逐条判例而非空谈原则——每个结论都落到具体案例的一个具体动作
标准更新：敢于用新标准重排全行业座次——评级体系的立法权属于敢于覆盖旧标准的人
modern_applications_en: Review-system design: compress a thousand scoring rules into one core category (e.g. 'did it change the user's mind'), then unfold it into opposing poles
Write reviews as case law, not principle-talk — every verdict lands on a concrete action in a concrete case
Update standards boldly: re-rank the whole field by the new criterion — the power to legislate a rating system belongs to those who will cover the old one
representative_figures: 王国维（核心）
严羽（前驱：《沧浪诗话》'兴趣'说——王国维试刀后嫌其不透的前一代标准）
朱光潜、宗白华（下游：现代中国美学皆自'境界'发端——《诗论》直接续写境界说）

modes.domain_zh: 学习心理学/把长期事业的进程拆成三重递进境界——以三句旧词为隐喻给成长曲线立法
modes.domain_en: Psychology of learning / cutting a long undertaking into three ascending realms — legislating the growth curve through three borrowed verses as metaphor
modes.definition_zh: 学习心理学/《人间词话》第 26 则是全书流传最广的段落：'古今之成大事业、大学问者，必经过三种之境界'——第一境引晏殊'昨夜西风凋碧树。独上高楼，望尽天涯路'：目标期——登高望远，看清全局长路，伴随孤独与迷茫；第二境引柳永'衣带渐宽终不悔，为伊消得人憔悴'：投入期——长期专注的消耗，身体与生活的代价照付不悔；第三境引辛弃疾'众里寻他千百度，蓦然回首，那人却在灯火阑珊处'：贯通期——长期积累后于不经意处突然贯通。方法论要点有三：其一，用隐喻立法——三句现成旧词把说不清的成长阶段变成人人可背的心智模型，比任何学习论都传得远；其二，三段之间不可跳级——没有'望尽天涯路'的目标共识，'衣带渐宽'只是内耗，没有消耗性投入，'灯火阑珊'的顿悟永不到来；其三，顿悟是配额兑现不是运气——'蓦然回首'的前提是'寻他千百度'，这为后来的' incubation/illumination'学习理论提供了汉语版本
modes.definition_en: Psychology of learning: section 26 of the Remarks is its most quoted passage — 'those who achieved the great undertaking or the great learning, ancient or modern, all passed through three realms'; the first quotes Yan Shu — 'last night the west wind thinned the green trees; alone I climb the high tower and see to the end of the horizon road': the stage of aims — climbing to see the whole long road, with solitude and bewilderment; the second quotes Liu Yong — 'my sash grows loose and I do not repent; for her I am wasted to a shadow': the stage of investment — long concentrated expenditure, the cost to body and life paid without regret; the third quotes Xin Qiji — 'in the crowd I sought her a thousand times; suddenly turning my head, there she stands where the lantern light is dim': the stage of synthesis — after long accumulation, sudden insight where one least looked. Three points: first, legislation by metaphor — three ready-made old verses turn indescribable growth stages into a mental model everyone can recite, travelling farther than any treatise on learning; second, the stages admit no skipping — without the consensus of aims won in 'seeing to the end of the road', 'loosening sash' is mere self-consumption, and without the consuming investment the sudden lantern never lights; third, illumination is a quota redeemed, not luck — 'suddenly turning' presupposes 'sought a thousand times': a Chinese-language version of what learning theory later called incubation and illumination
modes.key_quote_zh: 古今之成大事业、大学问者，必经过三种之境界——顿悟是'寻他千百度'的配额兑现，不是运气。
modes.key_quote_en: Those who achieved the great undertaking or the great learning all passed through three realms — sudden insight is the quota redeemed after seeking a thousand times, never luck.
key_concepts: 隐喻立法 legislation by metaphor（三句旧词承载三阶段——心智模型的传播成本压到最低）
legislation by metaphor (three old verses carry three stages — the transmission cost of the mental model pressed to the minimum)
不可跳级 no skipping（目标共识在先、消耗投入在中、贯通在后——次序即因果）
no skipping (consensus of aims first, consuming investment second, synthesis last — sequence as causation)
顿悟配额 illumination quota（蓦然回首以千百度为前提——把顿悟纳入投入产出账）
illumination quota ('suddenly turning' presupposes a thousand searches — insight entered into the input-output ledger)
process_zh: 立第一境：登高把全局目标与长路看尽——接受'独上'的孤独成本，先共识后投入
付第二境：以可计量的持续消耗（衣带渐宽）兑换进度——把代价写进预算而非隐瞒
等第三境：保持日常积累直到'灯火阑珊'的贯通时刻——顿悟不预约但可等待
复盘分期：给团队讲成长阶段时用三境界叙事——让成员知道自己在第几境、下一境要付什么
process_en: Set the first realm: climb high and see the whole road and goal — accept the cost of climbing alone; consensus before investment
Pay the second: convert measurable sustained expenditure (the loosening sash) into progress — put the price in the budget, do not hide it
Await the third: keep the daily accumulation until the dim-lantern moment of synthesis — illumination takes no appointment, but can be waited for
Review by stages: when explaining growth to a team use the three-realm narrative — each member knows which realm they stand in and what the next one costs
representative_cases_zh: 王国维自注三境界'此等语皆非大词人不能道'——他自己以考据与西学互证的十年为'衣带渐宽'，1912 年后转经学小学为'灯火阑珊'
后人在科研、创业、技艺训练中反复套用三境界叙事——'卡在第二境'成为描述长期投入期的公共语言
清华大学国学研究院时期，他要求学生先定问题再钻材料（望路）再苦读（渐宽）——三境界直接变成教学法
representative_cases_en: Wang annotated that 'only a great poet could have said such words' — his own decade of mutual verification of scholarship and Western learning was his 'loosening sash'; his turn to classics and philology after 1912, the 'dim lantern'
Later generations have recycled the three-realm narrative across research, entrepreneurship and craft training — 'stuck in the second realm' became public language for the long investment stage

At the Tsinghua Research Institute he required students to set the question before drilling the material (seeing the road) and then to study hard (loosening the sash) — the three realms turned directly into pedagogy
modern_applications_zh: 个人成长规划：把三年目标写成三境界分期——每期写清进入条件、退出条件与预期消耗
团队士气管线：在'第二境'消耗期主动讲三境界叙事——成员知道消耗是阶段不是绝路
长期项目投资：把'顿悟'当作投入配额的兑现来记账——不以单季产出否定长期项目
modern_applications_en: Personal growth planning: write the three-year goal as three realms — each with entry conditions, exit conditions and expected expenditure
Team morale pipeline: during the consuming second realm, tell the three-realm story deliberately — members learn the drain is a stage, not a dead end
Long-horizon investment: book 'insight' as the redemption of an investment quota — never kill a long project on one quarter's output
representative_figures: 王国维（核心）
晏殊、柳永、辛弃疾（材料：三句宋词的原作者——被借为成长隐喻的词人）
格拉德威尔（异源同构：'一万小时'的现代版投入叙事——与'衣带渐宽'互补的两套账）

modes.domain_zh: 美学理论/在'优美'与'壮美'之外立第三范畴'古雅'——为天才作品之下的工艺性成就立法
modes.domain_en: Aesthetic theory / establishing 'classical elegance' as a third category beyond the beautiful and the sublime — legislating for the craft-level achievement below the work of genius
modes.definition_zh: 美学理论/《古雅之在美学上之位置》(1907) 是中国第一篇有完整康德美学框架的论文。王国维接过康德的二分（优美/宏壮）后，发现它解释不了大量作品：既非天才独创又不靠自然力量，只因形式完美与功力纯熟而美的东西——法书、名画、古器、乃至二流诗人的佳作。他为这一层立名'古雅'：'古雅之位置，可谓在优美与宏壮之间，而兼有此二者之性质'——其价值来源是'修养'而非'天才'，是'后天'而非'自然'。方法论要点：其一，发现评价体系的空档——在天才与自然两端之外，存在靠修炼可达的中间带；其二，为空档命名并论证其独立价值——'三代之钟鼎、秦汉之摹印……皆由形式之雅正而生'；其三，把中间带制度化为'学力'的领地——天才不可学，古雅可学：这给了常人一条可操作的审美进阶路径。这是一次完整的'补充立法'：不推翻康德框架，而是在框架的缝隙里增设一个新范畴
modes.definition_en: Aesthetic theory: On the Position of Classical Elegance in Aesthetics (1907) is the first Chinese essay with a complete Kantian aesthetic framework. Taking over Kant's dichotomy (the beautiful / the sublime), Wang found it could not explain a great mass of works: not original genius, not force of nature, yet beautiful by perfection of form and ripeness of craft — calligraphy, famous paintings, antique vessels, even the fine work of second-rank poets. He named this layer 'classical elegance': 'its position may be said to lie between the beautiful and the sublime, partaking of both' — its value comes from 'cultivation' not 'genius', from the 'acquired' not the 'natural'. The method: first, find the gap in the evaluative system — beyond genius and nature there is a middle band reachable by training; second, name the gap and argue its independent value — 'the tripods of the Three Dynasties, the seals of Qin and Han… are beautiful from the rectitude of their form alone'; third, institutionalise the middle band as the territory of 'learned power' — genius cannot be learned; elegance can: this gave ordinary people an operable ladder of aesthetic progress. A complete act of supplementary legislation: Kant's framework is not overturned — a new category is installed in its gap
modes.source_chapter: 《古雅之在美学上之位置》(1907，《教育世界》)
modes.key_quote_zh: 古雅之位置，在优美与宏壮之间——天才不可学，古雅可学：评价体系里要给'可修炼的中间带'立法。
modes.key_quote_en: The position of classical elegance lies between the beautiful and the sublime — genius cannot be learned; elegance can: an evaluative system must legislate for the trainable middle band.
key_concepts: 体系空档发现 finding the system's gap（优美/壮美解释不了的中间带——评价空白即立法机会）
finding the system's gap (the middle band the beautiful and the sublime cannot explain — an evaluative blank is a chance to legislate)
修养性价值 value from cultivation（古雅源于功力而非灵感——'后天'是独立的价值来源）
value from cultivation (elegance comes from craft, not inspiration — the 'acquired' is an independent source of value)
补充立法 supplementary legislation（不推翻框架而在缝隙增设范畴——最小的改动覆盖最大的空白）
supplementary legislation (add a category in the framework's gap without overturning it — the smallest change covering the largest blank)
process_zh: 审视现行评价体系：找出它解释不了的大量实例——被两分法漏掉的中间地带
为空档命名并论证独立价值：证明该层级的价值来源不同（修养而非天才）——不是低配版而是另一维度
确立可学性：明示该范畴可通过修炼达到——给常人可行路径是范畴的生命力所在
挂靠大框架：新范畴标注与原体系的接口（介于两者之间而兼有二性）——补充而非革命
process_en: Audit the current evaluative system: find the mass of cases it cannot explain — the middle ground missed by the dichotomy
Name the gap and argue its independent value: show its source of value differs (cultivation not genius) — not a lesser copy but another dimension
Establish learnability: state plainly the category can be reached by training — a feasible path for ordinary people is what keeps a category alive
Anchor to the parent framework: mark the interface (between the two, partaking of both) — supplement, not revolution
representative_cases_zh: 以'古雅'重估法书名画与二流诗人：不具天才独创性的作品第一次获得独立的美学地位——如宋以后仿古器物的形式价值
论证'三代钟鼎秦汉摹印'之美纯由形式雅正而来——把工艺传统纳入美学领地而非仅'文物'领地
把'可学'写进结论：学古雅以'学力'积累——中国美育传统中'功夫'叙事第一次拿到哲学户口
representative_cases_en: By 'elegance' he re-valued calligraphy, paintings and second-rank poets: works without original genius gained an independent aesthetic standing for the first time — as with the formal value of archaist vessels after the Song
He argued the beauty of the Three Dynasties' bronzes and Qin-Han seals comes purely from rectitude of form — bringing the craft tradition into the territory of aesthetics, not merely of 'antiquities'
He wrote learnability into the conclusion: elegance accrues by 'learned power' — the narrative of 'kung-fu' in Chinese aesthetics received its philosophical residence permit for the first time
modern_applications_zh: 职级体系设计：在'天才档'（突破性创新）与'合格档'之外设'手艺档'——为精湛但非原创的工作正名
补充立法机会：发现现有制度解释不了的常见情形，增设一个有独立价值来源的中间类别
人才培养：明示哪些成就'可学'——把不可复制的天才叙事与可修炼的工艺叙事分开管理
modern_applications_en: Career-ladder design: beside the 'genius band' (breakthrough innovation) and 'qualified band', add a 'craft band' — honouring exquisite but non-original work
Chances for supplementary legislation: where the current scheme cannot explain common cases, add a middle category with its own source of value
Talent development: state which achievements are 'learnable' — manage the unreplicable genius narrative separately from the trainable craft narrative
representative_figures: 王国维（核心）
康德（框架来源：《判断力批判》优美/崇高二分——被补充立法的对象）
朱光潜（下游：《文艺心理学》延续'修养可学'的中间带论证）

modes.domain_zh: 文学观念/把文学从'载道'与'游戏'两极拉回独立位置——以哲学定义给一门艺术办'独立户口'
modes.domain_en: Conception of literature / pulling literature back from the twin poles of 'moral carriage' and 'game' to an autonomous position — registering an art as independent by philosophical definition
modes.definition_zh: 文学观念/《文学小言》(1906) 开篇：'昔雅里大德勒（亚里士多德）于伦理学中试解何为德；若夫文学，则未有以为独立之价值者也'——王国维给中国文学办了一件前所未有的事：以'餔錣的文学'（decorate）与'文绣的文学'（ornament）为耻，主张'文学者，游戏的事业也'——但此'游戏'非消遣，而是康德式'无目的的合目的性'：文学的价值在自己身上，不在载道也不在消遣。方法论要点：其一，双面拒斥——既拒儒家'文以载道'的工具化，也拒科举'羔雁之具'（敲门砖）的功利化，两条流行道路同时否定才显出第三条路；其二，用哲学定义代替历史惯例——文学独立的根据不是'古已有之'而是审美自律原理；其三，以判例执行标准——'诗至唐中叶以后……无足观者'等判词，皆以'有无独立价值'为刀。这是为整个文类办的'独立户口'：从为政治、道德、科举服务的附属品，变成自有领地的艺术门类
modes.definition_en: Conception of literature: the Literary Aphorisms (1906) open — 'Aristotle sought to define virtue in his ethics; but for literature, no one had yet held it to have an independent value'; Wang did for Chinese literature something never done before: ashamed of literature as decoration and as ornament, he declared 'literature is the affair of play' — yet this play is not pastime but the Kantian 'purposiveness without purpose': literature's value lies in itself, neither in carrying the Way nor in diversion. The method: first, double rejection — refuse both the Confucian instrumentalisation of 'writing to carry the Way' and the examination-culture utilisation of literature as 'the goose-and-goose Implements' (a door-knocking brick); only negating both popular roads at once reveals the third; second, philosophical definition instead of historical precedent — literature's independence rests not on 'the ancients had it' but on the principle of aesthetic autonomy; third, enforce by case law — verdicts like 'poetry after the mid-Tang… is not worth looking at' all wield the blade of 'independent value or none'. This was an independent household registration for a whole genre: from appendage serving politics, morality and the examinations, to an art with a territory of its own
modes.source_chapter: 《文学小言》(1906)；《论哲学家与美术家之天职》(1905)
modes.key_quote_zh: 文学者，游戏的事业也——此'游戏'非消遣，是无目的的合目的性：价值在自己身上。
modes.key_quote_en: Literature is the affair of play — not pastime but purposiveness without purpose: its value lies in itself.
key_concepts: 双面拒斥 double rejection（同时否定载道与消遣——两极之外的第三条路才立得住）
double rejection (refuse both moral carriage and diversion at once — only beyond both poles does the third road stand)
哲学定义 philosophical definition（以审美自律立户——不靠'古已有之'的历史惯例）
philosophical definition (registered by aesthetic autonomy — not by the precedent of 'the ancients had it')
判例执行 enforcement by case law（'无足观者'式判词——标准要有牙齿）
enforcement by case law (verdicts like 'not worth looking at' — a standard must have teeth)
process_zh: 找被两极夹击的对象：确认该领域的价值被两种流行叙事（工具化/消遣化）同时遮蔽
给出哲学定义：以原理（自律/无目的的合目的性）而非惯例为对象立户——定义要能对抗两极的引力
执行判例：用新标准对领域内作品重排与除名——标准不执行等于没立
承担代价：独立宣言会同时得罪两端——立法者要接受边缘地位（王国维自认'钻营'者不齿）
process_en: Find the object squeezed by two poles: confirm the field's value is veiled by two popular narratives (instrumentalisation / pastime)
Give the philosophical definition: register the object by principle (autonomy, purposiveness without purpose), not convention — the definition must resist both poles' gravity
Enforce by case law: re-rank and strike out works in the field by the new standard — an unenforced standard is none
Bear the cost: a declaration of independence offends both ends — the legislator must accept marginal standing (Wang accepted the contempt of careerists)
representative_cases_zh: 《论哲学家与美术家之天职》痛陈'我国无纯粹之哲学……亦无纯粹之美术'——把哲学家与艺术家从'政治的仆役'身份中要求解放
以'无独立价值'重评唐中叶以后诗与清代科举文学——判词得罪主流而奠定了'纯文学'的批评传统
《红楼梦评论》以叔本华哲学评《红楼梦》为'彻头彻尾之悲剧'——中国第一部以哲学而非考据评小说的专论
representative_cases_en: In On the Vocation of Philosophers and Artists he lamented 'our country has no pure philosophy… nor pure art' — demanding liberation of philosopher and artist from the status of 'political servants'
He re-valued post-mid-Tang poetry and examination literature as 'of no independent value' — verdicts that offended the mainstream and founded the critical tradition of 'pure literature'

His Essay on the Dream of the Red Chamber judged the novel 'a tragedy through and through' by Schopenhauer's philosophy — the first Chinese monograph to read fiction by philosophy rather than by philology
modern_applications_zh: 专业独立性建设：为被'业务指标'与'内部娱乐'两极夹击的专业职能（研究/设计）办独立户口——以专业原理立户
标准有牙齿：立了标准就要出除名判例——'无独立价值'式的裁决保护标准的严肃性
边缘定位自觉：独立路线短期两头不讨好——把'边缘'当作立场纯度的证明而非失败
modern_applications_en: Building professional independence: for functions squeezed between 'business metrics' and 'internal entertainment' (research, design), register an independent household by professional principle
Standards need teeth: once set, issue striking-out verdicts — 'of no independent value' rulings protect a standard's seriousness
Conscious marginality: the independent route pleases neither side at first — treat the margin as proof of purity of position, not failure
representative_figures: 王国维（核心）
康德、叔本华（框架来源：审美无利害与唯意志论悲剧观——独立户口的哲学担保人）
鲁迅（对照：同时代的文学观——'不用之用'与王国维'游戏说'同向而路径不同）

modes.name_en: Sorrow for Life and for the Age
modes.domain_zh: 美学理论/伟大作品的两种根源性 sorrow——'忧生'与'忧世'的二元起源论
modes.domain_en: Aesthetic theory / the two root sorrows of great works — 'sorrow for life' and 'sorrow for the age' as a dual-origin theory
modes.definition_zh: 美学理论/《人间词话》删稿中提出：诗人'对宇宙人生，须入乎其内，又须出乎其外'，并判'词人者，不失其赤子之心者也'；而在《文学小言》中他给出伟大作品的二元起源：'所著之诗词，若忧生，若忧世'——'忧生'是个体生命有限性的形而上悲哀（叔本华式的生命意志之苦），'忧世'是家国时代的具体忧患（屈原杜甫式的政治承担）。方法论要点：其一，区分两种 sorrow 的层级——忧生是哲学的、普遍的、不可解决的；忧世是历史的、特殊的、可行动的；其二，二者可以叠加但不可互相替代——李煜'生于深宫之中'却写出'自是人生长恨水长东'，亡国之痛（忧世）穿透为生命之痛（忧生）才成其大；其三，'入乎其内/出乎其外'是产能条件——'入乎其内，故能写之；出乎其外，故能观之'：沉入体验与抽出观照的双态切换，是创作与批评共同的姿势。这为'什么是伟大作品'提供了可操作的起源检测
modes.definition_en: Aesthetic theory: in the deleted drafts of the Remarks he holds that the poet 'must enter into the universe and life, and also stand outside them', and judges 'the ci poet is one who has not lost the heart of a child'; in the Literary Aphorisms he gives the dual origin of great works: 'the poems written, whether of sorrow for life, or of sorrow for the age' — 'sorrow for life' is the metaphysical grief of individual finitude (the Schopenhauerian pain of the will to live); 'sorrow for the age' is the concrete anguish of family, state and era (the political burden of a Qu Yuan or Du Fu). The method: first, the two sorrows differ in level — sorrow for life is philosophical, universal, unsolvable; sorrow for the age is historical, particular, actionable; second, they may compound but not substitute — Li Yu, 'born deep in the palace', yet wrote 'life's long regret flows east like the water, ever flowing': the pain of losing a realm (for the age) must penetrate into the pain of being alive (for life) to become great; third, 'entering within / standing outside' is the condition of output — 'entering within, he can write it; standing outside, he can behold it': the two-mode switch between immersion and detached viewing is the common posture of creation and criticism alike. This yields an operable origin-test for 'what makes a work great'
modes.source_chapter: 《人间词话》及其删稿；删稿第 25 则；王国维《文学小言》(1906)
modes.key_quote_zh: 入乎其内，故能写之；出乎其外，故能观之——沉入与抽离的双态切换，是创作与批评共同的姿势。
modes.key_quote_en: Entering within, he can write it; standing outside, he can behold it — the two-mode switch of immersion and detachment is the posture of creation and criticism alike.
key_concepts: 二元起源 dual origin（忧生是形而上的普遍之苦，忧世是历史的特殊之痛——检测作品先问根源）
dual origin (sorrow for life is the universal metaphysical grief; for the age, the particular historical pain — test a work by asking its origin)
穿透放大 penetration-amplification（忧世穿透为忧生才成其大——具体苦难接通普遍苦难）
penetration-amplification (sorrow for the age becomes great only as it penetrates into sorrow for life — particular suffering wired to universal suffering)
双态切换 two-mode switch（入内以写、出外以观——沉浸与观照交替供能）
two-mode switch (enter to write, stand out to behold — immersion and contemplation alternate as the power supply)
process_zh: 检测根源：评价一部作品先问它的 sorrow 是哪一种——只有时代牢骚而无生命之思者为浅
检查穿透：具体忧患是否穿透为普遍生命体验——没有穿透的忧世只是时事评论
切换双态：工作时入内（沉浸写）、评审时出外（抽离观）——两种姿势不混用
守住赤子：警惕世故侵蚀感受力——'不失赤子之心'是长期产出的心理学前提
process_en: Test the origin: ask first which sorrow a work issues from — the age's grumbling without thought of life is shallow
Check the penetration: has the particular anguish penetrated into universal experience of life? Sorrow for the age without penetration is mere commentary
Switch the modes: enter within when working (immersed, writing), stand outside when reviewing (detached, beholding) — do not mix the postures
Guard the child's heart: guard sensitivity against the erosion of worldliness — 'not losing the child's heart' is the psychological premise of long output
representative_cases_zh: 判李煜词为'以血书者'：'自是人生长恨水长东'——亡国之忧世穿透为生命之忧生，故'俨有释迦、基督担荷人类罪恶之意'
评'入乎其内/出乎其外'：周邦彦入而未出、姜夔出而未入——用双态标准给宋代大家做产能诊断
他自己的一生是二元的注脚：甲骨考据是'忧世'（为国保文献），《红楼梦评论》与词话是'忧生'（为生命问意义），最终昆明湖的抉择把二者合一
representative_cases_en: He judged Li Yu's ci 'written in blood': 'life's long regret flows east like the water' — the sorrow of a lost realm penetrating into the sorrow of life itself, hence Li Yu 'bears, like Sakyamuni and Christ, the sins of mankind'
On 'entering / standing outside': Zhou Bangyan entered without standing out, Jiang Kui stood out without entering — a capacity diagnosis of the Song masters by the two-mode standard

His own life footnotes the duality: oracle-bone scholarship as sorrow for the age (securing the nation's documents), the Red Chamber essay and Remarks as sorrow for life (asking the meaning of living) — the choice at Kunming Lake united the two
modern_applications_zh: 作品评价框架：评审时先分'时代反馈'与'生命问题'两层——能穿透两层的才给最高评级
工作模式管理：创作期与评审期物理隔离（入内/出外）——同一时段不混用沉浸与抽离
长期续航：把'赤子之心'（未被世故磨损的好奇与敏感）列为核心资产的年度检查项
modern_applications_en: Work-evaluation frame: on review, first separate 'feedback of the age' from 'questions of life' — only works penetrating both layers get the top rating
Work-mode management: physically separate creation from review (enter / stand out) — never mix immersion and detachment in one session
Long-horizon endurance: list 'the child's heart' (curiosity and sensitivity uncorroded by worldliness) as a core asset with an annual check
representative_figures: 王国维（核心）
李煜（判例：'以血书者'——忧世穿透忧生的最大标本）
叔本华（哲学来源：生命意志之苦——'忧生'的形而上担保）

modes.name_en: Mutual Limiting of Doubt and Trust
modes.domain_zh: 学术方法论/在'疑古'与'信古'两军对垒中走第三条路——证据既疑既信，让新出土物当裁判
modes.domain_en: Scholarly methodology / the third road in the standoff between 'doubting the ancients' and 'trusting them' — evidence at once doubted and trusted, with new excavated finds as umpire
modes.definition_zh: 学术方法论/1920 年代古史大论战：顾颉刚疑古派以'层累地造成的中国古史'摧毁传统古史体系，信古派则抱残守缺。王国维不走任一极端，其立场可概括为疑信互限：对纸上记载持限度的怀疑——'纸上之材料未得证明者，不能认为肯定事实'；同时对地下出土持限度的信任——出土即实证，但只证其出土所证。《古史新证》明言'虽古书之未得证明者，不能加以否定'——怀疑不等于否定：未被证明的旧记载悬置待证，而不判死刑。方法论要点：其一，怀疑与相信都要有证据阈值——两边的断言都过同一道闸门；其二，让新材料做裁判而非让立场做裁判——'事实所示，不容买椟还珠'；其三，保持可逆：今天的'证'可被明天的出土推翻——知识状态永远是'迄今'。这使王国维成为论战中双方都不敢轻视的一方：疑古派尊其方法，信古派用其结论
modes.definition_en: Scholarly methodology: in the great debate on ancient history of the 1920s, Gu Jiegang's doubting school demolished the traditional system with the 'layered fabrication of ancient Chinese history', while the trusting school guarded the remnants. Wang took neither extreme; his stance can be called the mutual limiting of doubt and trust: a bounded doubt toward transmitted texts — 'what on paper has not been verified cannot be held an established fact'; and a bounded trust toward what the ground yields — an excavation is proof, but proves only what it proves. The New Evidence states plainly that 'transmitted books not yet verified may not on that account be negated' — doubt is not denial: an unverified old record is suspended pending evidence, not condemned to death. The method: first, doubt and belief both need an evidence threshold — assertions on both sides pass the same gate; second, let new material umpire, not one's position — 'what the facts show admits no keeping the casket and returning the pearl'; third, keep reversibility: today's verification may be overthrown by tomorrow's excavation — the state of knowledge is always 'as of now'. This made Wang the one side in the debate neither camp could slight: the doubters honoured his method, the trusters used his conclusions
modes.source_chapter: 《古史新证》(1925)；1920 年代古史论战诸篇
modes.key_quote_zh: 虽古书之未得证明者，不能加以否定——怀疑不等于否定：未被证明的，悬置待证而不判死刑。
modes.key_quote_en: Transmitted books not yet verified may not on that account be negated — doubt is not denial: the unverified is suspended pending evidence, not condemned to death.
key_concepts: 证据阈值 evidence threshold（疑与信都过同一道闸门——不因立场放宽或收紧）
evidence threshold (doubt and belief pass the same gate — loosened or tightened for no one's position)
悬置待证 suspension pending proof（未证实≠已证伪——中间状态是合法知识状态）
suspension pending proof (unverified is not falsified — the middle state is a legitimate state of knowledge)
材料裁判 material as umpire（让出土物而非立场定案——裁判权交给新证据）
material as umpire (excavated finds settle the case, not positions — jurisdiction belongs to new evidence)
process_zh: 对两极各设阈值：'要证据'的规则同时适用于疑与信——杜绝单边免检
区分'未证'与'证伪'：不合法地跳到否定——悬置是默认状态
引入增量证据：新出土/新数据到岸即重审悬案——裁判权在材料手里
标注知识状态：结论一律写'迄今'——为未来的推翻预留接口
process_en: Set thresholds for both poles: the 'show evidence' rule applies to doubters and trusters alike — no unilateral exemption
Distinguish unverified from falsified: no illegitimate jump to negation — suspension is the default state
Admit incremental evidence: when new finds or data land, reopen the suspended case — jurisdiction lies with the material
Stamp the state of knowledge: conclusions are always 'as of now' — an interface reserved for future overthrow
representative_cases_zh: 论战中他既用卜辞证《殷本纪》大体不诬（信古派所得），又指出《五帝德》《帝系姓》等传世古史体系'后世之伪托'（疑古派所得）——两边同时受益
'虽古书之未得证明者不能加以否定'成为处置古籍的标准立场：如《山海经》长期悬置，后经出土材料部分印证
对殷先王世系：卜辞所证者信，卜辞未及者存疑——同一记载按证据覆盖面分级处置而非整体判决
representative_cases_en: In the debate he both used the oracle bones to show the Annals' Yin genealogy broadly uncorrupt (the trusters' gain) and declared the transmitted systems of the Five Sovereigns 'later fabrications' (the doubters' gain) — both sides benefited at once

'A transmitted book not yet verified may not on that account be negated' became the standard handling of ancient texts: as the Classic of Mountains and Seas long suspended, later partly confirmed by excavated material
On the Yin sovereigns: what the inscriptions verify is trusted, what they have not yet touched stays in doubt — one record graded by evidential coverage rather than judged whole
modern_applications_zh: 争议处置制度：对公司争议结论设'证据阈值'——同一闸门管质疑与辩护两边
中间状态合法化：明确'未证实'与'已证伪'的区别——悬置的结论标注'待证'而非删除
增量复审：新数据到岸即重审悬案——裁判权在数据不在立场
modern_applications_en: Dispute-handling system: one evidence threshold governs contested conclusions — the same gate for challenge and defence
Legalise the middle state: distinguish 'unverified' from 'falsified' — suspended conclusions are stamped 'pending', not deleted
Incremental re-review: new data on arrival reopens suspended cases — jurisdiction with the data, not the faction
representative_figures: 王国维（核心）
顾颉刚（对手兼同道：疑古派的'层累说'——被二重证据限定的另一极）
李学勤（下游：'走出疑古时代'的后续立法——以出土文献重审疑古判决）

modes.domain_zh: 生命哲学/把生命意志的绝境当作思考的最后实验场——为'意义问题无解时怎么办'给出自己的执行
modes.domain_en: Philosophy of life / treating the impasse of the will to live as the final laboratory of thought — giving one's own execution as the answer to 'what to do when the question of meaning has no answer'
modes.definition_zh: 生命哲学/王国维三十岁自序：'体素羸弱，性复忧郁，人生之问题日往复于吾前'——他把叔本华哲学当作对'人生之问题'的正式应答来研究，而非学术时尚：《红楼梦评论》以'欲与生活与痛苦，三者一而已矣'开篇，把悲剧读成对欲望-痛苦结构的展示；《人间词话》判'诗人对宇宙人生须入乎其内又出乎其外'，把审美静观当作意志之苦的临时解药；而 1927 年 6 月 2 日昆明湖自沉，留下'五十之年，只欠一死；经此世变，义无再辱'——以自己的身体完成了对意义问题的最后执行。方法论要点：其一，把'无解之问'合法化为学术对象——人生意义不可解，但'如何面对不可解'可研究：他研究悲剧、研究静观、研究忧郁本身；其二，思想与行为保持同构——他讲'义无再辱'时使用的逻辑与其考据的逻辑同样严格；其三，把自己的终局当作体系的一部分：遗书十六字使'忧生'命题获得身体层面的最终判例。这一模式揭示的不是自尽的理由，而是一个把思考推到不能回头的深度的样板：所有的答案都要能对齐自己的生命实践
modes.definition_en: Philosophy of life: in his self-preface at thirty Wang wrote, 'my body is frail and my nature melancholy; the question of life circles before me daily' — he took up Schopenhauer's philosophy as a formal answer to 'the question of life', not an academic fashion: the Red Chamber essay opens 'desire, life and pain are one and the same thing', reading the tragedy as an exhibition of the structure of desire and pain; the Remarks judge that 'the poet must enter into the universe and life and also stand outside them', holding aesthetic contemplation as the temporary antidote to the pain of the will; and on 2 June 1927 he drowned himself in Kunming Lake, leaving 'fifty years of age; only death remains owed; having passed through this upheaval of the world, honour permits no second disgrace' — completing, with his own body, the final execution of the question of meaning. Three points: first, legalise the unsolvable question as an object of study — the meaning of life cannot be solved, but 'how to face the unsolvable' can be studied: he studied tragedy, contemplation, melancholy itself; second, keep thought and act isomorphic — the logic of 'honour permits no second disgrace' is as strict as the logic of his philology; third, make one's own end part of the system: the sixteen characters of the testament gave the proposition 'sorrow for life' its final case at the level of the body. What this mode reveals is not a reason for self-destruction but a specimen of thinking driven to a depth from which there is no turning back: every answer must align with one's own life practice
modes.key_quote_zh: 五十之年，只欠一死；经此世变，义无再辱——答案必须能对齐自己的生命实践。
modes.key_quote_en: Fifty years of age; only death remains owed; having passed through this upheaval, honour permits no second disgrace — every answer must align with one's own life practice.
key_concepts: 无解之问的合法化 legalising the unsolvable（意义问题不可解但'如何面对'可研究——把绝境变成对象）
legalising the unsolvable (the question of meaning cannot be solved, but 'how to face it' can be studied — the impasse made an object)
思想行为同构 isomorphism of thought and act（讲的逻辑与做的逻辑同严格——言行一致性是体系要求）
isomorphism of thought and act (the logic of speech as strict as the logic of deed — consistency as a systemic demand)
终局即判例 the end as case law（最后的行动是体系的最后判例——体系完整性延伸到生命）
the end as case law (the final act is the system's final precedent — the system's integrity extends to life itself)
process_zh: 承认无解：把最深的个人问题合法化为研究对象——不回避不化装
寻找临时解药：审美静观、学术工作是对意志之苦的临时处置——为不可解问题配置可操作缓冲
保持同构：宣称的原则与日常行为同一套逻辑——不允许'学术归学术生活归生活'的分裂
预置终局条款：为最深问题写好自己的答案边界——宁可代价巨大也不含糊其辞
process_en: Admit the unsolvable: legalise one's deepest personal problem as an object of study — neither evaded nor disguised
Seek the temporary antidote: aesthetic contemplation and scholarly work as the interim handling of the pain of the will — an operable buffer for the unsolvable question
Keep isomorphism: the principles professed and the daily conduct run on one logic — no split between 'academy' and 'life' permitted
Pre-set the endgame clause: write one's own boundary of answers for the deepest question — better a great price than an equivocation
representative_cases_zh: 三十岁自序明言治哲学是为'人生之问题'——研究对象的选择本身就是对绝境的处置方案
《人间词话》以'出入'说与'赤子之心'给出审美化的缓冲方案——把忧郁转化为批评理论的生产力
1927 年遗书十六字与自沉——'忧生'命题的最终判例：清华园停灵时陈寅恪撰碑言'独立之精神，自由之思想'，成为二十世纪中国学术的精神界碑
representative_cases_en: The self-preface at thirty states plainly that he studied philosophy for 'the question of life' — the choice of research object was itself a handling of the impasse
The Remarks offered the aestheticised buffer of 'entering and standing out' and 'the child's heart' — converting melancholy into the productive power of critical theory

The sixteen characters and the drowning of 1927 — the final precedent of 'sorrow for life': as he lay in state at Tsinghua, Chen Yinke's stele inscription 'independence of spirit, freedom of thought' became the spiritual boundary-stone of twentieth-century Chinese scholarship
modern_applications_zh: 重大原则决策：原则一旦宣称就要准备为它支付最大代价——降低'原则与行为解耦'的风险
长期项目的心理缓冲：为无解或超长问题配置临时处置（仪式/审美/运动）——缓冲不是解决方案而是续航装置
组织伦理底线：预置'义无再辱'式条款——有些事在第一次受辱时就该退出
modern_applications_en: Decisions of principle: once a principle is professed, be ready to pay its greatest price — lowering the risk of principle and conduct decoupling
Psychological buffering for long projects: for unsolvable or ultra-long questions provision interim handling (ritual, aesthetics, exercise) — a buffer is not a solution but an endurance device
Organisational ethical floor: pre-set 'no second disgrace' clauses — some matters one should exit at the first dishonour
representative_figures: 王国维（核心）
叔本华（哲学来源：意志与悲观主义形而上学——'忧生'的理论供应商）
陈寅恪（知己与判词人：'独立之精神，自由之思想'的碑文——为这一终局做出历史裁决）
